prompts.label: Mucus coating

visual.shape: organic log shape with natural lumpy irregular edges, normal stool form
visual.color: normal brown stool with a wet, glossy, translucent sheen on parts of the surface
visual.distinguishingFeature: visible wet slimy coating like clear snot or saliva on parts of the stool - translucent and shiny, NOT opaque white
visual.surface: some areas look normal matte brown, other areas have a visible wet glossy sheen like the stool passed through something slimy

prompts.prompt: Create a clean semi-realistic illustration, medical education style of dog stool for a veterinary education app. IMPORTANT: Use organic irregular shapes with natural lumpy edges, slight bulges, tapered ends. NOT perfect geometric cylinders or sharp clean edges. Real stool has uneven natural form like soft clay that was squeezed out. Use realistic natural earth tones, true-to-life colors. Background: plain solid light neutral gray (#F0F0F0) background, no textures or patterns. Rendering: soft shading with realistic form, gentle shadow underneath for grounding. Camera angle: slightly elevated 3/4 view, as if looking down at the ground. SHAPE: organic log shape with natural lumpy irregular edges, normal stool form. COLOR: normal brown stool with a wet, glossy, translucent sheen on parts of the surface. KEY IDENTIFYING FEATURE: visible wet slimy coating like clear snot or saliva on parts of the stool - translucent and shiny, NOT opaque white. SURFACE/TEXTURE: some areas look normal matte brown, other areas have a visible wet glossy sheen like the stool passed through something slimy. REAL LIFE REFERENCE: Brown stool that looks partially wet/slimy - like someone dripped clear hair gel or egg white on it, with visible wet shiny patches. Do NOT include: text or labels, cartoon faces or expressions, flies or insects, smell lines or stink marks, grass or outdoor environment, overly gross or disgusting details, perfect geometric shapes, sharp clean cylinder edges, machine-cut or manufactured looking shapes. This must look realistic enough that a pet owner can compare it to their dog's actual stool. The image should clearly show the distinguishing characteristics so owners know what to look for. Remember: ORGANIC irregular shapes like squeezed-out soft material, NOT perfect geometric cylinders.
